Nile crocodiles, hippos and venomous snakes share the same riverbanks, and every meeting between them is a gamble. In this episode of the Chronicles, we follow the Nile crocodile through its most dangerous encounters: a river rival that weighs several times more, and a snake whose bite works in a completely different way.
What decides these fights is rarely strength alone. We break down the position, the timing and the biology that tip each encounter, and what each animal risks when it chooses to engage.
